outcome: Development-Probe Machinery builds each declared approach once at the cross-case boundary, binds that immutable bundle identity into every case execution, and protects shared evidence by running each candidate from a disposable isolated source materialization.
practical_value: An experiment with M approaches and N cases retains M candidate bundles instead of M times N while preserving independent case execution, tamper detection, and downstream composition.
stopping_condition: Real two-approach, two-case runs retain exactly two canonical bundles and perform four executions; every case maps an approach to the same verified bundle digest; mutating candidate source invalidates only that execution while the shared bundle remains verifiable; legacy single-case launch and all-probe winner collection remain operational.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: Two approaches are built once each, execute across two cases, share one verified bundle identity per approach, and remain consumable by all-probe composition.
A source-mutating candidate becomes ineligible without changing the shared canonical bundle or preventing its subsequent verification.
